samples.loadFailed: Failed to load: {error} (switched to built-in sample)

footer.localOnly: All data is computed and rendered locally. No uploads or data collection.

export.tryLowerScale: Export failed. Try a smaller export scale.
export.selectHint: Drag to draw a box; drag/move handles to refine; click confirm to export.

inspect.orderHint: Computed in selection order: ∠(1–2–3) with point 2 as the vertex.

settings.modifiedHint: Detected modified settings for the current model. Relevant panels are now open.

session.restoreContent: A previous session with models and settings was found. Restore it?
session.restoreMissing: No cached models found. Please re-import.

settings.title: Settings
settings.clearStorageConfirmBody: This removes saved settings and cached models, then restores defaults.
settings.clearStorageHint: If the display looks wrong or settings get out of sync, try clearing settings and model cache.

view.viewPresetsNeedOne: Please keep at least one view preset selected (cannot uncheck the last one).
view.dualViewSplitHint: Adjust the width ratio between front (left) and side (right) view.

rotation.speedHint: Speed is adjusted independently; the preset only defines the axis (direction).

tilt.name: Tilted axis
tilt.hint: A slightly tilted axis that often looks good

lammps.alert: When a LAMMPS dump or LAMMPS data file provides only numeric types, specify the element symbol for each type here to ensure correct color/radius, bond inference, and stable rendering.

files.openFileHint: You can also drag & drop a file onto the canvas. New loads are added as layers and previous layers are hidden by default.

export.hint: Higher scale looks sharper but creates larger files and slower exports

project.hint: ZIP contains config.json; uncached remote models will be re-fetched via URL.

layers.hint: Click a row to set the active layer for per-layer colors or display; use the toggle to show/hide.

other.refreshBondsOnPlay: Refresh bonds each frame while playing
other.keepActiveLayerOnHide: Keep active layer when hiding a layer
other.themeReadabilityCheckOnOpen: Check theme readability when opening viewer
other.selectionColorHint: Used for selection halos, lines, and fill.
other.selectionColorResetTooltip: Reset to the built-in selection highlight color.
other.visualStyleHint: Switch preset colors and atom thickness.

colors.alert: After editing colors, click “Refresh” to apply them to the model.
colors.invalidHex: Invalid color format. Please use #RRGGBB or #RGB.
colors.resetTooltip: Reset to the built-in default color of this element.
colors.hint: Tip: If the active layer has typeId (e.g. LAMMPS), colors are keyed as element+typeId (C.1, C.2, ...); otherwise they are keyed by element.
colors.empty: No editable atom types in the active layer.

details.alert: These options are saved per layer. Turn on “Edit all layers” to broadcast changes.
details.hint: Atom size and bond settings do not affect other layers unless you choose to edit all layers.
details.bondFactorHint: Used to infer bonds: cutoff = (r_i + r_j) × bondFactor. Larger values create bonds more easily.
details.sphereSegmentsHint: Higher values look smoother but are slower to render.
